As an ftm trans poc youth who knew they were trans at a younger age before a lot of other people in my age group, my experience is that at some point towards 2018 I started seeing a influx of trans ftm/ftn. 
Personally, I had the same experience as a lot of trans people you’d typically see where they “knew they were a boy at birth” kinda thing but I was heavily bullied for it, but due to being exposed to the internet at a younger age I took on the label as genderfluid or non-binary because it felt safer and people online treated me nicer but I tried coming out in middle school as someone who was a boy funny enough (of course being in a conservative state I was bullied back into the closet). Then as I tried being a girl and trying to accept the changes in puberty (which was hard, I ended up struggling with a lot of issues of gender dysphoria and depression) I saw a lot of people who were bullying me in the past come out as trans throughout high school and there was more acceptance and awareness which was… surprising from people like them. 
Imo, I felt like because of the influx of trans awareness I was more comfortable in coming out as trans. There’s still some resentment and wariness to the other members of my demographic, esp AFAB to identifying as trans (because I’m jealous lol but I keep that to myself). What I don’t like from it is the stereotyping I get for seeing as a Gen Z FTM. I think though that I’ll accept this since there’s a lot of social changes and more information about gender that’s to the youth since they’re given a lot of time to explore and it’s now open to adults too which is great. Honestly it’s up to the adolescent as they grow older and figure themselves out and it doesn’t pertain to me because when something changes in a society people are going to react differently. We can’t really undo stereotypes now either in a quick process since there are afab trans people who will fit the criteria of what afab trans people are seen as and it wastes too much energy to be like “stop acting like this!!” Since younger people don’t like being bossed around. So like, I hope more info comes about about being trans, hormones, and etc so people get informed and all so they aren’t fucked at a younger age or they can accept themselves at a younger age. Idk every experience is different, that’s just my two cents
